records.literal_gloss: And answered [the] angel of Yahweh and said, Yahweh of hosts, until when you not will have compassion on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, which you have been indignant [with] this seventy years?

en.L: And the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} answered and said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, how long will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not have compassion on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, with which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been indignant these seventy years?"
en.B: Then the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, how long will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hold back {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion from Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been angry with these seventy years?"
en.R: Then the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, "{{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, how much longer will it be before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} show compassion to Jerusalem and the towns of Judah? You have been angry with them for seventy years now."

fr.L: Et l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} répondit et dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, jusqu’à quand n’auras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas compassion de Jérusalem et des villes de Juda, contre lesquelles {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es irrité depuis ces soixante-dix ans ? »
fr.B: Alors l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, jusqu’à quand refuseras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} compassion à Jérusalem et aux villes de Juda, contre lesquelles {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es en colère depuis soixante-dix ans ? »
fr.R: Alors l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a dit : « {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, combien de temps faudra-t-il encore attendre avant que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} aies pitié de Jérusalem et des villes de Juda ? Voilà soixante-dix ans que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es en colère contre elles. »

es.L: Y el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} respondió y dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, ¿hasta cuándo no tendrás compasión de Jerusalén y de las ciudades de Judá, contra las cuales has estado indignado estos setenta años?».
es.B: Entonces el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, ¿hasta cuándo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} negarás {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión a Jerusalén y a las ciudades de Judá, con las que has estado enojado durante estos setenta años?».
es.R: Entonces el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dijo: «{{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, ¿cuánto tiempo más pasará antes de que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} tengas compasión de Jerusalén y de los pueblos de Judá? Ya hace setenta años que estás enojado con ellos».

sw.L: Na malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajibu, akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, hadi lini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutauhurumia Yerusalemu na miji ya Yuda, ambayo umeikasirikia miaka hii sabini?"
sw.B: Ndipo malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, hadi lini utazuia huruma {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa Yerusalemu na miji ya Yuda, ambayo umeikasirikia miaka hii sabini?"
sw.R: Ndipo malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasema, "Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, itachukua muda gani zaidi kabla hujaonyesha huruma kwa Yerusalemu na miji ya Yuda? Umeikasirikia kwa miaka sabini sasa."

vi.L: Thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đáp lời và nói: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, cho đến bao giờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không thương xót Giê-ru-sa-lem và các thành của Giu-đa, là những nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nổi giận suốt bảy mươi năm nay?"
vi.B: Bấy giờ thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn ngưng lòng thương xót đối với Giê-ru-sa-lem và các thành của Giu-đa cho đến bao giờ? Ngài đã giận những nơi ấy bảy mươi năm nay rồi."
vi.R: Bấy giờ thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thưa: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, còn bao lâu nữa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mới tỏ lòng thương xót đối với Giê-ru-sa-lem và các thành của Giu-đa? Ngài đã giận chúng suốt bảy mươi năm nay rồi."

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사가 대답하여 말했다. "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 이 70년 동안 진노하신 예루살렘과 유다의 성읍들을 언제까지 불쌍히 여기지 않으시겠습니까?"
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사가 말했다. "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서 70년 동안이나 진노하신 예루살렘과 유다의 성읍들에게 언제까지 긍휼을 베풀지 않으시겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사가 말했다. "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 언제쯤 예루살렘과 유다의 성읍들에 자비를 베푸시겠습니까? 주님께서 70년 동안이나 그들에게 화를 내셨습니다."

pt.L: E o anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} respondeu e disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, até quando não terás compaixão de Jerusalém e das cidades de Judá, contra as quais estás indignado estes setenta anos?"
pt.B: Então o anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, até quando vais negar a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} compaixão a Jerusalém e às cidades de Judá, com as quais estás irado há setenta anos?"
pt.R: Então o anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} disse: "{{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, quanto tempo ainda vai passar até que tenhas compaixão de Jerusalém e das cidades de Judá? Já faz setenta anos que estás irado com elas."

decisions.choice: seventy years: the time of judgment Jeremiah had foretold
decisions.reason: Jeremiah said that the nations would serve the king of Babylon for seventy years, and that after seventy years God would bring his people home (Jeremiah 25:11-12; 29:10; compare 2 Chronicles 36:21; Daniel 9:2). Here the angel counts the years of God's anger with Jerusalem. From the burning of the temple in 586 BC to this vision in 519 BC was nearly seventy years, and the rebuilt temple was finished in 515 BC (Ezra 6:15), about seventy years after its destruction. The number is also a round figure for a full lifetime of judgment. 7:5 counts seventy years of fasting in the same way.

decisions.choice: how long: a lament in which the angel pleads with God for Jerusalem
decisions.reason: "How long" is the cry of the psalms of lament (Psalm 13:2-3; 74:10; 79:5). Here it is a heavenly being who speaks it for the people. The riders found the nations at ease (verse 11), so the time has come for the LORD to show mercy to his city.

decisions.choice: you have been indignant with: the LORD's anger against Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The verb names hot anger, often God's anger in judgment (Malachi 1:4, of Edom; Isaiah 66:14). It is stronger than the anger of verse 2.

decisions.choice: the LORD addressed with no "O"; you with the deity_pronoun setting
decisions.reason: The angel speaks to the LORD directly, so the name is written as a vocative with no "O", as in the Psalms, and "you" and "your" for the LORD take the setting for pronouns of God. Balanced says "hold back your compassion"; Readable makes the second clause a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "miaka sabini"
decisions.reason: The seventy years of Jeremiah 25:11-12, worded as there. The vocative is "Ee BWANA wa majeshi", with the Swahili "Ee".

decisions.choice: The angel prays in 합쇼체: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, … 언제까지 … 않으시겠습니까?"; the seventy years are "70년"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for this prayer; Jeremiah's seventy years are written in figures at every level, as 2 Chronicles 36:21.

decisions.choice: SENHOR dos Exércitos (vocative, no article); tu to God
decisions.reason: The angel speaks to the LORD (m2), so the name stands as a vocative without an article inside the span, and the angel says "tu", as anyone speaking to God does in Portuguese. The verbs carry the person, so the English "you" has no pronoun to take a span; "a tua compaixão" (B) does.

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나와 말하던 천사에게 좋은 말씀, 위로하는 말씀으로 대답하셨다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나와 말하던 천사에게 좋은 말씀과 위로의 말씀으로 대답하셨다.
ko.R: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나와 말하던 천사에게 대답하셨다. 그분께서는 그에게 다정한 말씀, 위로의 말씀을 하셨다.

pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu ao anjo que falava comigo com palavras boas e consoladoras.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} respondeu ao anjo que falava comigo. Falou a ele palavras bondosas, palavras de consolo.

decisions.choice: the LORD answers the angel who talked with Zechariah
decisions.reason: The plea came from the angel of the LORD (verse 12), but the answer is given to the angel who explains the visions, who passes it on to Zechariah in verses 14-17. Zechariah does not report the LORD's words directly; he hears them through the angel.

decisions.choice: good words, comforting words: words of promise
decisions.reason: "Good words" are words that promise good, the opposite of words of judgment (Joshua 23:14-15). Jeremiah had promised, "When seventy years are completed ... I will fulfill to you my good word" (Jeremiah 29:10). The word for comfort recalls Isaiah 40:1, "Comfort, comfort my people", and verse 17 says that the LORD will comfort Zion.

decisions.choice: kind words (R)
decisions.reason: In English "good words" can mean well-chosen words. Readable says "kind words", which is close to the sense here, and keeps "words of comfort".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔י קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת קִנֵּ֧אתִי לִירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וּלְצִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said to me the angel who talks with me, Proclaim, saying, Thus says Yahweh of hosts: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion [with] jealousy great.

en.L: And the angel who talked with me said to me, "Call out, saying, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: I have been jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with great jealousy.
en.B: Then the angel who talked with me said to me, "Proclaim this: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: I am deeply jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion.
en.R: Then the angel who talked with me said, "Announce this message: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: I am very jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion. I love them and will protect them.

fr.L: Et l’ange qui parlait avec moi me dit : « Proclame, disant : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : J’ai été jaloux pour Jérusalem et pour Sion d’une grande jalousie.
fr.B: Alors l’ange qui parlait avec moi me dit : « Proclame ceci : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Je suis profondément jaloux pour Jérusalem et pour Sion.
fr.R: Alors l’ange qui parlait avec moi m’a dit : « Annonce ce message : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Je suis très jaloux pour Jérusalem et pour Sion. Je les aime et je les protégerai.

es.L: Y me dijo el ángel que hablaba conmigo: «Proclama, diciendo: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: He tenido celo por Jerusalén y por Sion con gran celo.
es.B: Entonces el ángel que hablaba conmigo me dijo: «Proclama esto: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Siento un celo profundo por Jerusalén y por Sion.
es.R: Entonces el ángel que hablaba conmigo me dijo: «Anuncia este mensaje: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Siento un gran celo por Jerusalén y por Sion. Las amo y las protegeré.

sw.L: Na malaika aliyezungumza nami akaniambia, "Tangaza, ukisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Nimeona wivu kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu na kwa ajili ya Sayuni kwa wivu mkuu.
sw.B: Ndipo malaika aliyezungumza nami akaniambia, "Tangaza hivi: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Nina wivu mwingi kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu na kwa ajili ya Sayuni.
sw.R: Ndipo malaika aliyezungumza nami akasema, "Tangaza ujumbe huu: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Nina wivu mwingi kwa ajili ya Yerusalemu na kwa ajili ya Sayuni. Ninaipenda na nitailinda.

vi.L: Thiên sứ đang nói với tôi bảo tôi: "Hãy kêu lên rằng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Ta đã ghen vì Giê-ru-sa-lem và vì Si-ôn với lòng ghen lớn lao.
vi.B: Bấy giờ thiên sứ đang nói với tôi bảo tôi: "Hãy công bố điều này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Ta nổi ghen mãnh liệt vì Giê-ru-sa-lem và vì Si-ôn.
vi.R: Bấy giờ thiên sứ đang nói với tôi bảo: "Hãy loan báo sứ điệp này: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Ta rất ghen vì Giê-ru-sa-lem và vì Si-ôn. Ta yêu thương họ và sẽ bảo vệ họ.

ko.L: 그러자 나와 말하던 천사가 나에게 말했다. "너는 외쳐 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 예루살렘과 시온을 위하여 큰 질투로 질투하였다.
ko.B: 그러자 나와 말하던 천사가 나에게 말했다. "너는 이렇게 외쳐라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 나는 예루살렘과 시온을 위하여 몹시 질투한다.
ko.R: 그러자 나와 말하던 천사가 말했다. "너는 이 말씀을 알려라. '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 나는 예루살렘과 시온을 위하여 몹시 질투한다. 나는 그들을 사랑하며 지켜 줄 것이다.

pt.L: E o anjo que falava comigo me disse: "Proclame, dizendo: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Tenho tido zelo por Jerusalém e por Sião com grande zelo.
pt.B: Então o anjo que falava comigo me disse: "Proclame isto: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Tenho um zelo profundo por Jerusalém e por Sião.
pt.R: Então o anjo que falava comigo disse: "Anuncie esta mensagem: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: Tenho um amor zeloso por Jerusalém e por Sião. Eu as amo e vou protegê-las.

decisions.choice: jealous for: full of zeal for someone who belongs to me, and fiercely protective
decisions.reason: The word is used of God's passionate devotion, which will not share his people with other gods (Exodus 20:5; 34:14) and rises up to defend them (Joel 2:18, "the LORD became jealous for his land"; Isaiah 9:6, "the zeal of the LORD"). It is not envy. Here it means the LORD's burning concern for Jerusalem, which turns into anger against those who harmed her (verse 15). The same words open the promises of 8:2.

decisions.choice: call out: Zechariah is to proclaim the LORD's answer
decisions.reason: The angel tells Zechariah to proclaim aloud what the LORD has said. The message runs to the end of verse 16, and a second proclamation follows in verse 17.

decisions.choice: I have been jealous ... with great jealousy (L); deeply jealous (B); I love them and will protect them (R); the quotation marks
decisions.reason: Literal gives the verb's completed form as "I have been jealous": the LORD's zeal is not new. Balanced gives the strengthening noun as "deeply". Readable keeps "jealous" and adds what it means here, love that protects (m1), since in everyday English the word usually means envy. The angel's words are in double quotation marks, and the message Zechariah is to proclaim is in single marks inside them; it closes at the end of verse 16.

decisions.choice: "jaloux pour Jérusalem", "jalousie" at L and B; R adds "Je les aime et je les protégerai" as the English Readable
decisions.reason: The LORD's jealousy is his burning love for what is his, not envy; French keeps "jaloux" so the word matches Zephaniah 1:18 and 3:8, and the angel's speech opens « » with the message in “ ” from 1:14 to 1:17.

decisions.choice: « » opened here and “ ” inside, closed in verse 17
decisions.reason: The angel's words run from here to the end of verse 17, with the message he gives inside them; Spanish uses « » for the angel and “ ” for the message, as the published Spanish nests quotations, and does not close and reopen them at each verse.

decisions.choice: "celo"
decisions.reason: Qin'ah of God is "celo", his zeal for what is his, as in Zephaniah; R adds what it means, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "wivu" (jealousy) for God's zeal
decisions.reason: God's jealousy is his burning zeal for what is his, as the meaning decision says; "wivu" is the word the published text uses for it (Joel 2:18; Zephaniah 1:18), and Readable spells out what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ghen" for God's jealousy, as in Zephaniah 1:18
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: zeal for what belongs to God and fierce protection; Readable adds what it means, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: *qinne'* is "질투하다" at every level, with "큰 질투로" (L) and "몹시" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Zephaniah 1:18 and 3:8, Korean keeps "질투" for God's jealous zeal; the footnoted meaning decision explains that it is fierce protective love, which Readable adds as the English Readable does. The angel's quotation opens " " and the message inside it ' ', closed at 1:17, as the English.

decisions.choice: zelo (L, B); amor zeloso (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 8:2): the LORD's passionate devotion (m1) is "zelo" at Literal and Balanced and "amor zeloso" at Readable, the words Ezekiel 5:13 sets in Portuguese for qin'ah. "Ciúme" today suggests suspicion and envy, which the meaning note rules out.

source.text: וְקֶ֤צֶף גָּדוֹל֙ אֲנִ֣י קֹצֵ֔ף עַל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם הַשַּֽׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ קָצַ֣פְתִּי מְּעָ֔ט וְהֵ֖מָּה עָזְר֥וּ לְרָעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [with] anger great I am angry at the nations the at ease, that I was angry a little, and they helped for evil.

en.L: And with great anger I am angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was angry [only] a little, but they helped [it] toward disaster.
en.B: And I am very angry with the nations that feel so secure. I was only a little angry with my people, but they made the disaster worse.
en.R: And I am very angry with the nations that think they are safe. I was only a little angry with my people. But those nations went too far and made their suffering much worse.

fr.L: Et d’une grande colère je suis irrité contre les nations qui sont tranquilles ; car {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, j’étais irrité [seulement] un peu, mais elles ont aidé au malheur.
fr.B: Et je suis très en colère contre les nations qui se croient en sécurité. Je n’étais qu’un peu en colère contre mon peuple, mais elles ont aggravé le malheur.
fr.R: Et je suis très en colère contre les nations qui pensent être en sécurité. Je n’étais qu’un peu en colère contre mon peuple. Mais ces nations sont allées trop loin et ont rendu ses souffrances bien pires.

es.L: Y con gran enojo estoy enojado contra las naciones que están tranquilas; porque yo estaba enojado [solo] un poco, pero ellas ayudaron para el mal.
es.B: Y estoy muy enojado con las naciones que se sienten tan seguras. Yo estaba solo un poco enojado con mi pueblo, pero ellas agravaron el mal.
es.R: Y estoy muy enojado con las naciones que creen estar a salvo. Yo estaba solo un poco enojado con mi pueblo. Pero esas naciones fueron demasiado lejos e hicieron mucho peor su sufrimiento.

sw.L: Nami nimeyakasirikia kwa hasira kuu mataifa yaliyostarehe; kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilikasirika kidogo [tu], lakini wao wakasaidia [kuleta] maafa.
sw.B: Nami nimeyakasirikia sana mataifa yanayojiona salama. Mimi niliwakasirikia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kidogo tu, lakini wao waliyazidisha maafa.
sw.R: Nami nimeyakasirikia sana mataifa yanayofikiri kwamba yako salama. Mimi niliwakasirikia watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kidogo tu. Lakini mataifa hayo yalipita kiasi na kuyafanya mateso yao kuwa makubwa zaidi.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giận lắm các nước đang an nhàn; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [chỉ] giận một chút, nhưng chúng đã góp phần làm tai họa [thêm].
vi.B: Ta rất giận các nước đang sống an nhàn. Ta chỉ giận dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một chút, nhưng chúng đã làm cho tai họa thêm nặng nề.
vi.R: Ta rất giận các nước tưởng mình được an toàn. Ta chỉ giận dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} một chút. Nhưng các nước ấy đã đi quá xa và làm cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} khổ sở hơn nhiều.

ko.L: 그리고 나는 평안히 지내는 민족들에게 크게 진노한다. 내가 [조금만] 진노하였는데, 그들이 재앙을 더하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그리고 나는 안심하고 지내는 민족들에게 몹시 진노한다. 나는 내 백성에게 조금만 노하였는데, 그들은 재앙을 더 크게 만들었다.
ko.R: 그리고 나는 자기들이 안전하다고 생각하는 민족들에게 몹시 화가 나 있다. 나는 내 백성에게 조금만 화를 냈다. 그런데 그 민족들은 지나치게 굴어서 내 백성의 고통을 훨씬 더 크게 만들었다.

pt.L: E com grande ira estou irado contra as nações que estão tranquilas; pois eu estava irado [só] um pouco, mas elas ajudaram para o mal.
pt.B: E estou muito irado com as nações que se sentem tão seguras. Eu estava só um pouco irado com o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, mas elas aumentaram a desgraça.
pt.R: E estou muito irado com as nações que pensam que estão seguras. Eu estava só um pouco irado com o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo. Mas essas nações passaram dos limites e fizeram o sofrimento do {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo ficar muito pior.

decisions.choice: at ease: careless and complacent in their security
decisions.reason: The word can mean peaceful in a good sense (Isaiah 33:20), but it is often used of those who are proud and careless because they feel safe (Amos 6:1; Isaiah 32:9, 11). It picks up the report of verse 11: the nations are at ease while Jerusalem lies in ruins.

decisions.choice: I was angry a little: my anger with my people was limited
decisions.reason: The word can mean "a little" in amount or "for a little while" (Isaiah 54:7-8, "for a brief moment I forsook you"). Either way, the LORD's anger with his own people had a limit, and the nations went beyond it.

decisions.choice: they helped toward disaster: they made the punishment worse than God intended
alternatives: they helped to bring about evil
decisions.reason: The nations were used to punish Judah (Isaiah 10:5-7), but they did it with cruelty and pride (Isaiah 47:6; Jeremiah 50:11; Obadiah 10-14). "Helped" is ironic: they did more harm than their task required. "Disaster" is the word often used for evil in the sense of harm.

decisions.choice: with my people (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "I was angry a little"; Balanced and Readable add who the anger was against, which verses 2 and 12 make plain. Readable adds "went too far", to make the sense of "helped toward disaster" plain (m3).

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה שַׁ֤בְתִּי לִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ בְּֽרַחֲמִ֔ים בֵּיתִי֙ יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְקָ֥ו יִנָּטֶ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion; my house will be built in it, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, and a line will be stretched over Jerusalem.

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion; {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house will be built in it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and a line will be stretched over Jerusalem.'
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: I have returned to Jerusalem with compassion. My house will be rebuilt in it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and a measuring line will be stretched out over Jerusalem.'
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: I have come back to Jerusalem to show it compassion. My temple will be built there again, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. Builders will stretch out their measuring lines over Jerusalem.'

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je suis revenu à Jérusalem avec compassion ; {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison y sera bâtie, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et un cordeau sera tendu sur Jérusalem.”
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Je suis revenu à Jérusalem avec compassion. Ma maison y sera rebâtie, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et on tendra le cordeau sur Jérusalem.”
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je suis revenu à Jérusalem pour lui montrer {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} compassion. Mon temple y sera reconstruit, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Les bâtisseurs tendront leurs cordeaux sur Jérusalem.”

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Me he vuelto a Jerusalén con compasión; {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa será edificada en ella, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y el cordel será tendido sobre Jerusalén”.
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: He vuelto a Jerusalén con compasión. Mi casa será reconstruida en ella, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y se tenderá un cordel de medir sobre Jerusalén”.
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: He vuelto a Jerusalén para mostrarle compasión. Mi templo volverá a construirse allí, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Los constructores tenderán sus cordeles de medir sobre Jerusalén”.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Nimeirudia Yerusalemu kwa huruma; nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itajengwa ndani yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kamba itanyooshwa juu ya Yerusalemu.'
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Nimeirudia Yerusalemu kwa huruma. Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itajengwa upya ndani yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, na kamba ya kupimia itanyooshwa juu ya Yerusalemu.'
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Nimerudi Yerusalemu kuuonyesha huruma. Hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} litajengwa huko tena, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Wajenzi watanyoosha kamba zao za kupimia juu ya Yerusalemu.'

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Ta đã trở lại cùng Giê-ru-sa-lem với lòng thương xót; nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được xây trong đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và dây đo sẽ được giăng trên Giê-ru-sa-lem.'
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ta đã trở lại cùng Giê-ru-sa-lem với lòng thương xót. Nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được xây lại trong thành, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và dây đo sẽ được giăng ra trên Giê-ru-sa-lem.'
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta đã trở lại với Giê-ru-sa-lem để tỏ lòng thương xót. Đền thờ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ được xây lại tại đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Thợ xây sẽ giăng dây đo trên Giê-ru-sa-lem.'

ko.L: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 내가 긍휼을 가지고 예루살렘에 돌아왔다. 그 안에 내 집이 지어질 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그리고 예루살렘 위에 측량줄이 펼쳐질 것이다.'
ko.B: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내가 긍휼을 품고 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다. 그곳에 내 집이 다시 세워질 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 예루살렘 위에 측량줄이 펼쳐질 것이다.'
ko.R: 그러므로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내가 예루살렘에 자비를 베풀려고 돌아왔다. 그곳에 내 성전이 다시 세워질 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 건축하는 사람들이 예루살렘 위에 측량줄을 펼칠 것이다.'

pt.L: Portanto, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Voltei para Jerusalém com compaixão; a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa será edificada nela, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, e um cordel será estendido sobre Jerusalém.'
pt.B: Por isso, assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Voltei para Jerusalém com compaixão. A {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} casa será reconstruída nela, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos, e um cordel de medir será estendido sobre Jerusalém.'
pt.R: Por isso, é isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Voltei para Jerusalém para mostrar compaixão por ela. O {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} templo vai ser construído ali de novo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos. Os construtores vão estender os seus cordéis de medir sobre Jerusalém.'

decisions.choice: I have returned: the LORD's return is as good as done
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a completed act, though the rebuilding is still ahead. The LORD speaks of his decision as already carried out. It answers the call of verse 3, "return to me, and I will return to you".

decisions.choice: my house will be built: the temple then being rebuilt
decisions.reason: The work on the temple had begun again five months earlier (Haggai 1:14-15) and was finished in 515 BC (Ezra 6:15). The promise assures the builders that their work will be completed.

decisions.choice: a measuring line will be stretched out: the city will be laid out for rebuilding
decisions.reason: Builders stretched a line to mark out what was to be built (Job 38:5; Jeremiah 31:39). The same picture is used of destruction in 2 Kings 21:13 and Isaiah 34:11, but here it is for building. It looks ahead to the man with a measuring line in 2:5. The written and read forms of the word differ slightly in spelling, not in meaning.

decisions.choice: temple (R); builders (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for "house", which is what is meant, and names the builders, since the passive verb implies them. The single quotation mark closes the message begun in verse 14.

decisions.choice: "kamba ya kupimia" (B, R); "kamba" (L)
decisions.reason: The measuring line as 2 Kings 21:13; here it lays out the city for rebuilding, not for judgment.

decisions.choice: "dây đo" for the measuring line
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording, as 2 Kings 21:13.

decisions.choice: *rachamim* is "긍휼" (L, B) and "자비" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for *rachamim* (mercies, compassion), as in 1:12.

decisions.choice: um cordel (L); um cordel de medir (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 2:5): the builder's line (m3) is "cordel", the word Jeremiah 31:39 uses in Portuguese for the same picture; Balanced and Readable say what it is for, "de medir".

source.text: ע֣וֹד׀קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֛וֹד תְּפוּצֶ֥ינָה עָרַ֖י מִטּ֑וֹב וְנִחַ֨ם יְהוָ֥ה עוֹד֙ אֶת־צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Again proclaim, saying, Thus says Yahweh of hosts: Again will overflow my cities from good, and will comfort Yahweh again Zion, and will choose again Jerusalem.

en.L: Call out again, saying, 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: My cities will again overflow with good, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will again comfort Zion and will again choose Jerusalem.'"
en.B: Proclaim this as well: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: My cities will once again overflow with prosperity, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will again comfort Zion and again choose Jerusalem.'"
en.R: Announce this too: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: My towns will again be full of good things. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will comfort Zion again, and once more {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will choose Jerusalem as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own.'"

fr.L: Proclame encore, disant : “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Mes villes déborderont encore de biens, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} consolera encore Sion et choisira encore Jérusalem.” »
fr.B: Proclame aussi ceci : “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Mes villes regorgeront de nouveau de prospérité, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} consolera encore Sion et choisira encore Jérusalem.” »
fr.R: Annonce aussi ceci : “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Mes villes seront de nouveau remplies de bonnes choses. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} consolera encore Sion, et une fois de plus {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} choisira Jérusalem pour qu’elle soit à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.” »

es.L: Proclama otra vez, diciendo: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Mis ciudades otra vez rebosarán de bien, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} consolará otra vez a Sion, y escogerá otra vez a Jerusalén”».
es.B: Proclama también esto: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Mis ciudades rebosarán otra vez de prosperidad, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volverá a consolar a Sion y volverá a escoger a Jerusalén”».
es.R: Anuncia también esto: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Mis pueblos volverán a estar llenos de cosas buenas. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} volverá a consolar a Sion, y otra vez escogerá a Jerusalén como {{deity_pronoun:suya|Suya}}”».

sw.L: Tangaza tena, ukisema, '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itafurika mema tena, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifariji Sayuni tena, na ataichagua Yerusalemu tena.'"
sw.B: Tangaza pia hivi: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itafurika tena mafanikio, na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifariji Sayuni tena na kuichagua Yerusalemu tena.'"
sw.R: Tangaza na hili pia: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Miji {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itajaa tena vitu vizuri. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataifariji Sayuni tena, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} ataichagua Yerusalemu tena iwe mji {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.'"

vi.L: Hãy kêu lên lần nữa rằng: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Các thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại tràn đầy điều tốt lành, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lại an ủi Si-ôn và sẽ lại chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem.'"
vi.B: Hãy công bố thêm điều này: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Các thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại tràn đầy thịnh vượng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lại an ủi Si-ôn, lại chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem.'"
vi.R: Hãy loan báo thêm điều này: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Các thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lại đầy dẫy những điều tốt lành. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ lại an ủi Si-ôn, và một lần nữa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem làm của riêng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.'"

ko.L: 다시 외쳐 말하여라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 나의 성읍들이 다시 좋은 것으로 넘쳐흐를 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고, 다시 예루살렘을 택할 것이다.'"
ko.B: 또 이렇게 외쳐라. '만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 내 성읍들이 다시 풍성함으로 넘쳐흐를 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고 다시 예루살렘을 택할 것이다.'"
ko.R: 이 말씀도 알려라. '하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 내 성읍들이 다시 좋은 것으로 가득 찰 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로할 것이다. 다시 예루살렘을 자기 것으로 택할 것이다.'"

pt.L: Proclame outra vez, dizendo: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: As {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} cidades ainda transbordarão de bem, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ainda consolará Sião e ainda escolherá Jerusalém.'"
pt.B: Proclame também isto: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: As {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} cidades voltarão a transbordar de prosperidade, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} de novo consolará Sião e de novo escolherá Jerusalém.'"
pt.R: Anuncie também isto: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos diz: As {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} cidades vão ficar de novo cheias de coisas boas. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} vai consolar Sião outra vez e vai escolher de novo Jerusalém como a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} cidade.'"

decisions.choice: again, four times: the promise of renewal is stressed
decisions.reason: The small word for "again" or "once more" begins the verse and comes back three times in the message. Each blessing is a return of what was lost: the towns full, Zion comforted, Jerusalem chosen.

decisions.choice: overflow with good: be so full of prosperity that it spills over
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to spread out or scatter, and is used of springs that overflow (Proverbs 5:16). The towns will be so full that they spill over, a picture taken up in 2:8, where Jerusalem has too many people for walls.

decisions.choice: choose Jerusalem again: the LORD will again make it the place of his name
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy speaks of "the place the LORD your God will choose" for his name to dwell (Deuteronomy 12:5), and Jerusalem became that place (1 Kings 11:13). The exile seemed to undo the choice; the promise renews it. The same words come back in 2:16, and 3:2 calls the LORD the one "who has chosen Jerusalem".

decisions.choice: with good (L); with prosperity (B); full of good things (R); as his own (R)
decisions.reason: "Good" here means prosperity, as Balanced says. Readable adds "as his own" to say what choosing Jerusalem means. The marks close the second message and the angel's words, which began in verse 14.

decisions.choice: Inside God's message his name takes no -시- ("{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 다시 시온을 위로하고")
decisions.reason: God names himself in the third person here; the Isaiah note keeps God's own words without -시- and "께", while the formula "…께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" stays honorific.

decisions.choice: ainda ... ainda ... ainda (L); voltarão a ... de novo ... de novo (B); de novo ... outra vez ... de novo (R)
decisions.reason: The fourfold "again" (m1) is kept at every level, with the word Portuguese finds natural before each verb; Literal repeats "ainda" in the sense "once more".
